name: nekomata
description: A pixel-art cat cafe that visualizes your running Claude Code sessions, subagents, and CPU/GPU/Docker load as cats.

enumDescriptions: The original: flat, chunky cats on big pixels.
Midway: the same chunky cats on a finer grid, with shading and smiles.
Finer and cosier: outlined, shaded cats in a calm panelled room.
Follow the date: Christmas in December, Halloween in late October, and the seasons between.
Snow, a tree with lights and Santa hats.
A blazing window, ice cream and sunglasses.
Falling leaves, warm drinks and scarves.
nekomata.theme.description: A seasonal theme for the cafe. Themes are drawn for the 32bit style.

nekomata.port.description: Port the Nekomata server listens on.

nekomata.pythonPath.description: Python 3 interpreter used to run the bundled server.

nekomata.serverScript.description: Override path to fleet_dashboard.py. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with the extension.
